title: MV How to add toggle automatic battles to RPG Maker MV?

posts.author: Erencikefe
posts.body: So i wanted to make a horror game on MV, i used VX Ace for years and now switched to MV. I said i used it for years but yeah i'm not very good at it i just make games for fun lol. Anyways i want to make an option that whenever a fight occurs there can be a auto attack toggle. Like in Persona games, when you press Triangle every character uses melee attack on enemies until you press triangle again. Is there something like this?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
not directly, but you can do this indirectly.
you basically make a state with the trait "autobattle" and every battler with that state will change to that.
then you only need a way to apply that state to the entire party and remove it again.
that will likely need a plugin for button events or something like that.
